name: context-universal
description: The unified universal-context plugin — quality canon + curated best-of skills, distilled from ten source repos.

metadata.description: Install once, use in every project. A single deduplicated quality bar (canon/) plus ~24 curated skills, design review/deslop commands, personas, and native tooling.

plugins.name: context-universal
plugins.description: Deduplicated design/quality canon (anti-slop, motion, typography, color, 8pt spacing, copy, honesty) + curated skills across engineering discipline, design, research, knowledge-work, and marketing, plus one gated specialized skill (android-reverse-engineering).
